messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023 (i.e., a statutory holiday that fell on a weekday or was observed on a weekday, giving you a three‑day break).  
(Only the federal holidays that apply nationwide are shown; provincial holidays that create long weekends are listed where they exist.)

| Holiday | Calendar date (2023) | Observed (if needed) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|----------------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2** |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.)* | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20** |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Monday Jul 3 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** |
| **Remembrance Day** | Monday Nov 11 | — | **Sat Nov 9 – Mon Nov 11** |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** |

> **Quick note:**  
> • If a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada observes it on the following Monday (unless the holiday itself is on a Monday).  
> • Some provinces have extra long‑weekend holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador). If you need those, let me know!
